legacy_cleanup_conflict: Legacy container {target} test ownership changed; preserved without cleanup.
case_restart: Standard restart, data retention and restart-enter
test_description_unit: Verify shared behavior, failure handling, packaging and test entries.
test_description_new-default: Verify dedicated configuration and default image creation, leaving the container stopped.
test_description_missing-image: Verify unavailable images are rejected without leaving a target container.
test_description_list-info: Verify container listing, state information and name collision protection.
test_description_start-user-network: Verify standard startup, the container user, sudo and outbound networking.
test_description_running-guards: Verify running containers cannot be deleted or exported.
test_description_enter-running-default-e: Verify entering a running container and leaving it running after the default exit.
test_description_enter-stopped-stop-exit: Verify startup on entry and stopping the container after selecting Stop.
test_description_export-import: Verify backup export, reimport and preservation of user data.
test_description_overwrite-confirmation: Verify cancellation, refusal and explicit consent for backup overwrite.
test_description_ownership-and-stop-all: Verify unmanaged targets are refused and stop-all affects only managed containers.
test_description_delete-confirmation: Verify deletion is declined by default and requires explicit consent.
test_description_language-config: Verify saved language preferences, switching and help in both languages.
test_description_tui: Verify menu navigation and complete operation flows in a real terminal.
test_description_invalid-inputs: Verify invalid names, missing targets and corrupt backups are refused.
test_description_lifecycle-repeat: Verify repeated startup and shutdown preserve users and their data.
test_description_restart: Verify standard restart, data preservation and entering after restart.
test_description_unmarked-import: Verify unmarked native backups become managed on import and retain their data.
test_description_filesystems: Verify mounted reads and writes, exact unmounting, path protection and lifecycle restoration.
test_description_filesystem-recovery: Verify safe recovery from disconnected and stale mounts.
test_description_filesystem-menu: Verify mount selection, unmount selection and menu return.
test_description_dependency-install: Verify native sudo, authentication prompts and dependency installation inside the container.
test_description_gpu: Verify GPU computation, driver paths, switching and the boundary challenge with GPU disabled.
test_description_configuration-concurren: Verify stale updates are refused and concurrent configuration changes are preserved.
test_description_isolation-policy: Verify fixed isolation settings, approved devices and rejection of unsafe imports.
test_description_isolation-runtime: Use fresh host references to verify identities and boundaries around host files, devices and management interfaces.
test_description_legacy-migration: Verify explicit legacy migration, refusal of unsafe configuration and data preservation.
